text: The door of Dr. Roylott's room
why: The story has already called this room 'Dr. Roylott's chamber' and 'Dr. Roylott's room' (¶35, ¶158, ¶240), so the label names it correctly.

text: After the cry: Holmes leads the way down the corridor
why: ¶241 says that after the cry, 'he lit the lamp and led the way down the corridor.'

text: After the cry: Holmes strikes twice at the chamber door, with no reply from within
why: ¶241 says 'Twice he struck at the chamber door without any reply from within.'

text: After the cry: Holmes turns the handle and enters the chamber, Watson at his heels
why: ¶241 says 'Then he turned the handle and entered, I at his heels,' which matches the label.
